questions.question: How many bytes are in 3.5 KB?
A text file contains 2,000 characters stored in ASCII (1 byte per character). What is the file size in KB?
Calculate the size of a 640x480 pixel image with 8-bit colour depth in KB.
Which is larger: 0.5 GB or 600 MB? Show your working.

points.text: 0.5 GB = 0.5 x 1,000 = 500 MB. 600 MB > 500 MB, so 600 MB is larger.

questions.question: A sound file is recorded at 22,050 Hz with 8-bit samples for 60 seconds. Calculate the file size in MB.
Full-Mark Response A photo is 4.2 MB. Calculate how many photos of this size can be stored on a 16 GB memory card. Show your working and state any assumptions. [3 marks] <div class="

points.text: 16 GB = 16 × 1024 MB = 16384 MB Number of photos = 16384 ÷ 4.2 = 3900.95... Assumption: 1 GB = 1024 MB (binary prefix) and the storage has no overhead for file system metadata. Approximately 3900 photos can be stored.
